title: 26.35%-Efficiency and high-bifaciality n-TOPCon solar cells enabled by UV-ps laser-induced selective modification of double-layered SiOx/n+-poly-Si passivating contacts
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9217-9229
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02742J, Paper
Qinqin Wang, Kaiyuan Guo, Wangping Wu, Siwen Gu, Xinyu Zhang, Jingyu Cao, Zhao Wang, Yusif Mohammed Mukhtar, Jianning Ding
Double-layered SiOx/n+-poly-Si films with laterally modulated thickness applied in TOPCon solar cells can reduced recombination, enhance contact quality, decrease risk of paste burn-through of the passivation layer and reduce parasitic absorption.
